observations: Photo 0: one photo of a blue folding fat tyre bicycle on artificial grass and paving, side view from the drive side.

Very wide knobby tyres on three spoke mag style wheels, front suspension fork, rear shock on a folding full suspension frame, front and rear mudguards, rear derailleur with a multi speed cassette, disc brakes visible front and rear.
Tyre sidewall text partly readable as 'MAGISIE...' (photo 0), not enough to name a brand or model of the bike; no frame decal or model is legible.
A shop watermark 'SUNNYBEST SPORTS' runs across the middle of photo 0: this looks like a dealer's catalogue shot, not the seller's own photo of a bike they have used for six months.
The bike looks new and clean, but the photo is small and distant: chain, cassette, brake rotors, folding hinge and tyre tread cannot be inspected.
No accessories other than the mudguards are shown.

identity.kind: folding fat tyre bicycle (full suspension, multi speed, mag wheels)
read_from: photo 0 overall shape: fat tyres, folding frame, mag wheels, front and rear suspension

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a fat tyre bicycle.
Only mudguards visible in photo 0; no accessories laid out or listed.
No receipt or dated proof; the only photo is a dealer watermarked shot, which says nothing about this seller's purchase or use.
A still photo cannot show shifting or braking; no clip.
Photo 0 is distant and appears to be a dealer photo; no close ups of chain, cassette, rotors or bolts.
Originality of components cannot be established from one distant photo; needs inspection.

risks.risk: The photo is a dealer's watermarked catalogue shot and may not show the seller's actual bike, its colour, version or condition.
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the actual bike beside a handwritten note with the seller's name, today's date and a code we supply.
risks.if_unproven: Quote stays conditional on the agent seeing the bike; priced as a used folding fat bike in worst condition, and no money moves until the real bike matches.

risks.risk: Gears or brakes faulty, contrary to the claim.
risks.proof: A short clip riding the bike, shifting through every gear and squeezing each brake to a stop.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing gear and brake repair.

risks.risk: Folding hinge loose, cracked or worn, which is the weak point on folding frames.
risks.proof: Close up of the folding joint locked and unlocked, plus a clip rocking the frame at the hinge.

risks.risk: Rust or wear on chain, cassette, rotors and frame after six months of use.
risks.proof: Close ups of chain, cassette, both brake rotors and the frame welds in daylight.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as drivetrain worn and rusted.

risks.risk: Fat tyres worn or punctured, or mag wheels buckled.
risks.proof: Close up of each tyre tread and a clip spinning each wheel.

risks.risk: Accessories claimed as complete may be missing.
risks.proof: One photo with every accessory laid out next to the bike.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as bike only, no accessories.

risks.risk: Suspension fork or rear shock leaking or blown.
risks.proof: Clip compressing the front fork and rear shock by hand.

proof_requests: A fresh photo of the actual bike beside a handwritten note with today's date and the code we supply, from both sides.
A clip riding the bike, shifting through all gears and braking with each lever.
Close ups of the folding hinge locked and unlocked.
Close ups of chain, cassette, brake rotors and both tyre treads.
A photo of all accessories laid out beside the bike.
Purchase receipt or proof of the purchase date.
response.reason: The kind is clear from photo 0, a folding fat tyre bicycle, so it can be priced at worst case as a used one with gears, brakes, hinge and accessories unproven. The only photo carries a dealer's watermark, so the quote is conditional on fresh photos of the actual bike before any money moves.
